name: pdk-pyexcel-ods3-etl
instr:
Our energy portal now gives us half-hourly meter readings as ODS files saved from LibreOffice Calc, and what pyexcel_ods3.get_data returns doesn't match what we see when we open them. Rows come back shorter than the header, blocks of rows are missing, the hidden Lookup sheet and hidden columns show up, and cells under merged areas show values that aren't there in Calc. Two of the exports are in /data/meter-readings/.

Reading an ODS file (by path, from a stream, or as bytes with file_type="ods", and through pyexcel's get_book_dict too) should give what Calc shows. Every cell and row should be at its real position, however the file stores it, and formatting that runs to the edge of the sheet should still not come back or slow the read down. Hidden rows, columns and sheets should be left out by default, and returned in place with skip_hidden_row_and_column=False or skip_hidden_sheets=False. Only what the file marks as hidden counts as hidden. start_row, row_limit, start_column, column_limit, sheet_index and sheet_name should count only what's returned. A cell under a merged area should read as "", and with detect_merged_cells=True every cell of the area should get the merged value.

Files with none of this should read as before. The library is checked out in /app. Please keep flake8 clean, as the lint workflow runs it, and follow /app/AGENT.md if you touch /app/changelog.yml. There's no network; everything is installed in /opt/venv.
